text: livermore: 'No fresh break is printed to act on.' On my proxy a break need not be fresh: R13 fires on ABOVE_STRUCTURE or pct_from_pivot > 0, and PRCH is ABOVE_STRUCTURE at pct_from_pivot 9.65. The entry is not at market but a buy stop over bar_high 20.94 (C27); if it never fills, I am never in. mp_state is not my test; rs_rank_pct 97.69 and ret_63d 27.94 are (C23), with TIF ACCELERATION and cmf 0.14 confirming (C28). I hold SUPPORT at 3. One observable moves me: elder_pattern leaving ACCELERATION, or a red bar before the fill. I cannot see ma_40 or cci_20.
